undisclosed_aid_ukraine._note: No credible aggregate estimate of total undisclosed military aid to Ukraine was found. Kiel uses official/budget data and flags that several donors (DEU since 2025, ITA, FRA, and others) do not itemise. Use these as ranges/context, not additive to tracker totals (DEU and ITA amounts are largely already in Kiel totals).

notes: FX: USD->EUR at ECB 2024 annual average 1.0824 USD per EUR (EXR.A.USD.EUR.SP00.A = 1.08238); 2023 fallbacks at 1.0813.

population_gdp: World Bank WDI 2024 (API reachable on retry, lastupdated 2026-10-08); IMF WEO DataMapper fills SSD, SMR, TWN etc.; 2023 WB for GRL, IMN; PRK = Bank of Korea GNI estimate. GDP null for CUB, SYR, ERI and small territories (no 2023/2024 data in WB/IMF files; Cuba's official-rate USD GDP is unreliable). Kosovo has no M49 code. Channel Islands aggregate dropped.

refugees_hosted: 'count' = Eurostat temporary-protection stock (latest month, Jun-Sep 2026) for EU/EFTA, else UNHCR end-2025 refugees. UNHCR end-2025 values retained in each EU record for comparison. US Uniting-for-Ukraine parolees (~200k+) are not counted by UNHCR as refugees (USA shows 3,302).
military_to_russia values are sales/barter in most cases (DPRK, Iran, China), not gifts; flag before adding to 'aid' totals. Belarus has quantities only.
Belligerent sources (Ukrainian GUR/MFA/CCD, Russian MoD/FSB/IC) are flagged with 'BELLIGERENT' inside source strings.
Unit prices for shells/missiles are scenario assumptions from one academic study (Guseinova/FNF), not transaction prices; certainty D.
